title: Unit – 3 : Session – 5 : SLO – 2  |  Evaluating a Postfix Expression
sections: I. Algorithm to Evaluate a Postfix Expression
Step 1: Scan the postfix expression from left to right.
Step 2: If the symbol is an OPERAND, PUSH its value onto the stack.
Step 3: If the symbol is an OPERATOR, POP two operands (first pop = operand2, second pop = operand1),
compute operand1 OPERATOR operand2, and PUSH the result back.
Step 4: Repeat until the expression ends.
Step 5: The single value remaining on the stack is the result.
